Study and living conditions
Mykolaiv National Agrarian University consists of 11 buildings with a total area of 89,731 m
2
, including 69,735 m
2
of educational and laboratory facilities. The total area per student is 16.2 m
2
. The provision of educational space per student is 12.5 m
2
.
The material and technical base for training international students includes:
equipped classrooms for specialized disciplines with multimedia tools to provide students with a high-quality education;
comprehensive methodological support designed for educational activities and in-depth coverage of all disciplines according to the curriculum;
technical support with modern equipment enabling visual representation of theoretical materials and practical aspects of the profession;
specialized computer laboratories fully equipped with hardware and software necessary for teaching and improving the quality of educational services for students.
The availability of necessary equipment in classrooms and laboratories allows lessons to be conducted according to the academic plans, ensuring the educational process meets the requirements of the curriculum and standard course programs across all study areas.
Computer labs
are connected to the Internet, providing staff and students with access to modern sources of information.
Students have access to
dormitories
, canteens, buffets, sports facilities, libraries, and reading rooms located on the campus of Mykolaiv National Agrarian University.
MNAU has
4 dormitories
with 1,500 block-type places, with rooms for 2–3 students. All international students are provided with dormitory places. A separate floor in Dormitory No. 2 (located 50 meters from the main academic building) is allocated for them. Internet access is available, and there is a telephone in the lobby with international call access. 24/7 security and group curators ensure the safety of residents.
Each dormitory has a medical point. Agreements have been signed with Mykolaiv City Hospital No. 4 and City Polyclinic No. 3 to provide preventive medical examinations and urgent medical care for international students studying at MNAU.
The
student canteen
has 396 seats. The university also has three buffets.
The
sports complex
consists of four gyms with a total area of 3,034.1 m
2
.
Three
assembly halls
of the university can accommodate up to 740 people.
The university’s
scientific library
plays an important role in the educational process and has remained the main source for students’ theoretical knowledge and instructors’ scientific information since its foundation in 1984. The total area of the library is 1,594 m
2
, including 272 m
2
of storage. The library has 8 reading rooms with specialized, social sciences, and fiction literature.
The
electronic library
provides readers access to electronic resources, developed since 2003. Access to the “Electronic Library of Educational and Methodological Literature of MNAU” and other full-text databases (containing over a thousand documents) is available exclusively through the university’s local computer network. A
Wi-Fi
zone is also available in the electronic reading room for access to the library’s collections.
